D2_compatibility.additional_calls: Post-selection validation only, never per candidate-threshold Stage2 inference.
D2_compatibility.dispute_status: E2_V2_POLICY_SEMANTICS_AMENDMENT_REQUIRED if final independent review finds a substantive frozen-policy change; do not mask as approval.
D2_compatibility.proof_scope: Nonempty feasible decision set proof remains conditional on common cache/Q1. It does NOT guarantee the winning D2 gate passes Q3; numerical eligibility may fail after a mathematically feasible optimum.
D2_compatibility.reason: D2 frozen policy already uses the same frozen selected-row Stage2 inference for realized MOVE and the common all-row cache for TRAIN losses. Q3 checks that the chosen winner has those same bytes; it does not optimize, filter the decision grid, change guards or replace Stage2. Failure stops execution instead of selecting another decision.

privacy.composition: Inherit joint complementary suppression across D0/D1/D2, both folds, existing C/E releases, minimum201. No private mismatch counts, row indices, decisions, hashes, paths, score/tick/model values.

Q1.all_move_gate: One whole-job selected call on all rows; compare all bytes; never infer PASS from gate support.

empty_gate.proof: Exact full-N bool gate has no selected rows, selected/cache views float64 shape[0], original integrated skips predict_delta, full integrated delta is positive float64 zero and projected ticks HOLD current in original order; record source/anchor/model/gate bindings and explicit no-op verification. Missing proof is NOT_EXECUTED/BLOCKED, never unconditional PASS.

Q2.cache: A chunk values selected at same rows
Q2.claim_limit: B is not the original whole-job D0 numerical path; neither necessary nor sufficient for C/A equality.
Q2.evidence: Existing frozen60+60 synthetic fixtures and public root-cause projection; no private rerun in this increment.
Q2.future_optional_private_diagnostic: Requires separate exact bounded diagnostic binding/resource/privacy approval; absent from default V2 runner allowlist.
Q2.omission: Record NOT_EXECUTED_DIAGNOSTIC, never PASS; no fresh private telemetry from historical evidence.

Q3.all_move_gate: One whole-job selected call on all rows; compare all bytes; never infer PASS from gate support.

empty_gate.proof: Exact full-N bool gate has no selected rows, selected/cache views float64 shape[0], original integrated skips predict_delta, full integrated delta is positive float64 zero and projected ticks HOLD current in original order; record source/anchor/model/gate bindings and explicit no-op verification. Missing proof is NOT_EXECUTED/BLOCKED, never unconditional PASS.

Q3.failure_meaning: NUMERICAL_SEMANTICS_NOT_QUALIFIED_NOT_D2_PERFORMANCE_FAILURE; no DEV/rollout, fallback, re-batching, relaxation or second-best candidate.
Q3.routing: D2_gate = p > selected_context_decision, causal prior zero/nonzero, both contexts merged by immutable original row positions
